correctness.rationale: The 3-state synchronous Greenberg–Hastings rule on W_r has six unordered petal types with weights (1,2,2,1,2,1); the center and nonempty type support form a finite 3(2^6−1)=189-state exact quotient, and ordered orientation must be checked to exclude hidden periods. I independently used the stronger 3(2^9−1)=1533 ordered-petal support quotient, classified every case microscopically, found only least periods 1 and 3 and first entry t<=4, and calculated inclusion-exclusion coefficients of k^r for k=1..9. These match all ten asserted N_(t,p)(r), F^7=F^4, r=1 sharp t3 and r>=2 sharp t4. Independent direct labelled adjacency simulation also confirms all states r1..4. Finite quotient exhaustiveness combined with type-support lifting proves every r, not an empirical extrapolation.
